boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission activities and public-access spaces at the University of Redlands and nearby Redlands.

cards.title: Settle in for a Redlands Bowl concert
cards.subtitle: Redlands Bowl, Smiley Park
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or chair, arrive before the performance, and enjoy the outdoor program without an admission charge during the summer season.
cards.short_summary: An admission-free summer concert series at the city’s outdoor bowl.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Redlands describes the Redlands Bowl as an admission-free venue and lists Tuesday and Friday performances from June through August.
cards.source_title: Redlands Bowl and the Mission Gables Bowl House
cards.access_notes: Outdoor performances are listed for 8:00 p.m. on Tuesdays and Fridays, June through August; confirm the program before going.

cards.title: Browse the A. K. Smiley Public Library
cards.subtitle: 125 W. Vine St., Redlands
cards.notes: Meet at the library to browse, read, or use its public resources; check the library’s current operating information before setting a time.
cards.short_summary: A historic public library with free access to information and collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The City states that A. K. Smiley Public Library is intended to be forever free to Redlands inhabitants.
cards.access_notes: Public-library access is free; borrowing eligibility and hours may have separate rules.

cards.title: Explore the Lincoln Memorial Shrine
cards.subtitle: 125 W. Vine St., Redlands
cards.notes: Pair a library visit with the shrine’s Civil War and Lincoln-focused collections, and verify open hours with the library before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Lincoln and Civil War museum-library operated through the public library system.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s library budget identifies the Lincoln Memorial Shrine among services provided through A. K. Smiley Public Library’s free and open access.
cards.source_title: City of Redlands FY 2027–2028 Proposed Biennial Budget
cards.access_notes: Free public-library-system access is documented; verify shrine hours before visiting.

cards.title: Join Buddhist Meditation
cards.subtitle: Larsen Meditation Room 210, University of Redlands
cards.notes: Drop in for an hour of guided insight, loving-kindness, or concentration practice; the university lists the gathering as open to the community.
cards.short_summary: A community meditation hour in Larsen Meditation Room.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Redlands lists Buddhist Meditation as free and open to all in the community.
cards.access_notes: The listing describes a Thursday-evening gathering; confirm that the recurring session is meeting before attending.

cards.title: Try weekly Loving Kindness Meditation
cards.subtitle: University of Redlands virtual meditation offering
cards.notes: Use the current Meditation Room information to join a weekly virtual practice led through the university; no campus travel or purchase is needed.
cards.short_summary: A free, public weekly virtual meditation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: A University of Redlands faculty profile states that weekly virtual Loving Kindness Meditation is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Virtual offering; use the Meditation Room’s current details for the meeting link and schedule.

cards.title: Browse the Music College Fair
cards.subtitle: Watchorn Hall, 51 Chapel Dr., University of Redlands
cards.notes: Register, then compare information from participating music schools with friends or family at this public event in Watchorn Hall.
cards.short_summary: A free public gathering with music-school representatives.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Redlands says its September 19, 2026 Music College Fair is free and open to the general public, with registration requested.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 19, 2026, 2:00–4:00 p.m.; registration is requested.

cards.title: See an exhibition at the University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Gallery Building, 1200 E. Colton Ave., University of Redlands
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, then visit the Gallery Building at Colton Avenue and West Drive to spend time with student, faculty, or local art.
cards.short_summary: Campus gallery space with a documented program of exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Redlands identifies the University Art Gallery’s campus location and documents exhibitions there; its Art Faculty Show announcement states admission was free.
cards.access_notes: The cited exhibition was free; consult the current gallery calendar for the active exhibition and any event-specific requirements.

cards.title: Plan for the Redlands Juneteenth Celebration
cards.subtitle: Sylvan Park, 601 N. University St., Redlands
cards.notes: Bring friends to the city’s daytime celebration for live entertainment, educational exhibits, games, and community activity; no admission purchase is required.
cards.short_summary: A free, all-ages city celebration at Sylvan Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Redlands lists the 2026 Juneteenth Celebration at Sylvan Park as free admission and open to all.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 event occurred June 20; use the city’s recreation calendar for a future date.

cards.title: Join the Redlands Earth Day celebration
cards.subtitle: Smiley Park, Redlands
cards.notes: Choose a workshop or meet up at the community celebration for music, activities, and environmental-information tables without buying admission.
cards.short_summary: A city-supported free climate-action and community gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Redlands labels Redlands Earth Day 2026 free and identifies its Smiley Park community celebration.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 event occurred April 18; confirm a future event date and workshop registration details.

cards.title: Take a Mindful Movement and Yoga class
cards.subtitle: Larsen Meditation Room 210, University of Redlands
cards.notes: Arrive early for this beginner-friendly, breath-led movement class and use the session to stretch, reset, and spend time with the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A free beginner-friendly movement and yoga class.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Redlands describes Mindful Movement and Yoga as a beginner-friendly free class for students and community members.
cards.access_notes: Space is limited and the university recommends arriving early; confirm a current session before going.

warnings: Two city-event cards cite 2026 editions that have already occurred; use their official city pages to confirm future dates. The University Art Gallery source establishes a free exhibition, but active-exhibition access should be checked on the current gallery calendar.
